title: V: Hester at Her Needle

teacherSummary.text: Released, Hester chooses to stay. She lives in a lonely cottage on the edge of town and supports herself and Pearl by needlework, which becomes fashionable for everything except wedding veils. She gives to the poor, who insult her. She feels the letter gives her a strange sense of hidden sin in others.
